activities.description: Positions compass on point B of an angle.
Draws an arc intersecting both arms of the angle.
Moves compass to an intersection point and draws an interior arc.
Repeats the process on the other arm of the angle.
Marks the intersection of the interior arcs.
Uses a ruler to draw a line from the angle vertex (B) to the intersection point.
